name: PIJAlance News Intelligence
author: pijalance

sections.description:
PIJAlance News Intelligence puts a fact-checking desk inside your newsroom, and lets you offer the same checking to your readers.

For your newsroom. Your writers open News Intelligence, Newsroom desk in WordPress and check a claim, a quote or a link while they work, without leaving the dashboard and without a second login. Every check is charged to your workspace, so a writer is never asked to sign in or to pay. The desk shows how much of your allowance is left.

For your readers. Switch it on and your audience gets a way to check the rumours and forwarded messages going around a story: a “Check a claim” button in the corner, a check box you can drop into any article, an optional button at the end of posts, and an optional button when a reader selects text. Switch it off and your readers see nothing at all, while the desk keeps working.

With your workspace site key, a reader’s check runs inside your own page. They are not sent away, they are not asked to make an account, and they are not asked for money, because the check is charged to your newsroom. Without a key, a reader who presses Check is taken to chatniai.com, where our own rules apply.

The checking itself is done by the News Intelligence service at chatniai.com, built by PIJAlance Magazine, so improvements reach your site without a plugin update.

Features:

  • Newsroom desk: a check tool inside WordPress for your own writers.
  • How much of your workspace allowance is left, shown on the desk.
  • One switch that decides whether readers see anything at all.
  • “Check a claim” button on your public pages, with your own wording and side.
  • [news_intelligence] shortcode: a check box for any post, page or widget area.
  • Optional “Check this article” button at the end of posts.
  • Optional button that appears when a reader selects text.
  • Optional help assistant, Oye, as a round help button or on a Help page with [oye_help].

External services

This plugin connects to the News Intelligence service, operated by PIJAlance Magazine Limited at https://chatniai.com. It cannot do its job without it.

What is loaded: on your public pages the plugin loads a script from https://chatniai.com/widget.js. If you turn on the help assistant, it also loads https://chatniai.com/oye.js. Loading a script means the reader’s browser requests it from chatniai.com, so chatniai.com receives the reader’s IP address and browser details, as with any hosted script.

What is sent, and when: no claim text is sent when a page loads. When a reader presses Check, the text or link they chose to check is sent to chatniai.com so it can be checked. If you entered a site key, the key and your website address are also sent so the service can confirm that your website is allowed to use it. With the optional help assistant, a reader’s question is sent when they send it.

Terms of service: https://chatniai.com/terms
Privacy policy: https://chatniai.com/privacy-policy

Please mention this service in your own privacy notice.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin in Plugins, Add New, Upload Plugin, or install it from the directory, then activate it.
  2. Open Settings, PIJAlance News Intelligence and choose the buttons you want.
  3. Optional: paste a site key from platform.chatniai.com to run the check on your own page.
sections.faq:
Do my readers have to sign in?

With a workspace site key, no. The check runs on your own page and is charged to your newsroom, so a reader never sees a sign-in and is never asked to pay. Without a key, a reader who presses Check is taken to chatniai.com, where our normal rules apply.

Do I need an account to install it?

No. The reader buttons work without one. A workspace is only needed for the newsroom desk and for checks that run on your own pages.

Can I use the desk without showing anything to my readers?

Yes. Switch off “Offer my readers a way to check claims” and your site looks exactly as it did; only your writers see the desk.

Does it slow my site?

The script loads asynchronously after the page content.

Where do I place the check box?

Type [news_intelligence] in any post, page or widget area.

What data is collected?

See the External services section above.
sections.changelog:
1.3.0

  • New: Newsroom desk. Your writers check a claim inside WordPress, charged to your workspace, with the remaining allowance shown.
  • New: one master switch for everything readers see, so the desk can be used on its own.
  • Settings are now split into “For my newsroom” and “For my readers”, under their own News Intelligence menu.
  • Clearer wording throughout: this is a newsroom tool that readers may also use, not a verdict on your own reporting.

1.2.3

  • Screenshots added to the directory page. No change to how the plugin works.

1.2.2

  • Plugin icon and banner added for the directory page. No change to how the plugin works.

1.2.1

  • Prepared for the WordPress.org directory: licence header, uninstall cleanup, scripts loaded the WordPress way.

1.2.0

  • New: Site key setting for the full inline check on your own pages.

1.1.0

  • New: Oye, the help assistant, and the [oye_help] shortcode.

1.0.0

  • First release.
